description: The Chiikawa Mod brings the world of Chiikawa into Minecraft: the characters of Chiikawa come to live in your world, so you can experience the world of Chiikawa in Minecraft.

mods.name: Chiikawa
mods.description: Bring the world of Chiikawa into Minecraft: tameable little friends, a job system that lets them work on their own, and a music box that plays your own songs.

mods.name: Chiikawa
mods.description: Bring the world of Chiikawa into Minecraft: tameable little friends, a job system that lets them work on their own, and a music box that plays your own songs.

releases.notes:
### New features

- a face that blinks and talks, as Usagi's and Hachiware's do
- seven pages, from meeting them to calling them home
- a four-panel strip the pets act out themselves
- money is whatever the currency tag holds
- board levels and wild spawns come from data packs
- a pet at work carries nothing to say so
- a market stall of its own, under a pink-and-cream awning
- a labor board of its own, with a plate on the hook for every slip left
- a pet's doings in grey italics
- a pet tells its owner what it bought, and what it gave them
- a grey rucksack for anyone, three friends' pouches, modelled on the pets
- paper stickers in an ink line, and a pet screen with three pages
- a pet that stands up for its owner and knows where to stand
- no more mushroom slips, and weeding fills the gap
- a bell your pets hear from another world
- a board an owner pays up, and the hunting it puts out
- a plate of something hot, and a pet that gets on with it
- a bear backpack a pet wears, and ten more slots when it does
- presents, pocket money, and a counter the owner can use
- a pet with wages walks to a shop and buys itself something
- draw the music box too, and the last texture is gone
- draw the pet's backpack instead of blitting it
- fade a pet's label in and out
- show a pet's label when you could reach out and pet it
- a pet answers for itself when you look at it
- make the screens things to look at, not lists to read
- draw the mod's UI, and say over a pet's head what it is doing
- show what a pet is working on
- let pets take slips from labor boards and get paid
- let wild farmers pull weeds and pick mushrooms
- give wild pets a spawn tool and a home to roam around
- weigh intent scores by personality and time of day
- load pet personalities from data packs

### Fixes

- talk with Hachiware's give
- a pink U under the ω that stays joined to it
- open its mouth the way Usagi opens hers
- a new pet goes its own way, however it came
- the shop's and the board's buttons show, priced in emeralds
- a face a Bedrock model leaves out is not drawn
- never change the board while telling players about it
- a pet's hand is raised and small, as vanilla's own are
- a pet holds things the way vanilla and Touhou Little Maid do
- fifteen pockets to fill the grid, and the pet's doing centred
- the rucksack's straps go over the shoulders
- no label over the pet in its own screen
- count the blow that put the monster down, not the credit
- the client was building a menu ten slots short
- the server looks for pets left behind, not the pets
- walk close enough to actually reach the chest
- take the pet's status line out of its well
- say on the row which job may take a slip
- lay the world's widgets in layers, not all on one plane
- let the label's text win over its panel by polygon offset
- hide a pet's label behind the wall in front of it
- draw the pet label backdrop without depth writes
- draw the label over its backdrop, not under it
- hang the slip tag on the chest and walk through the board
- keep equipment in the doll and rehome revived free pets

releases.notes:
### New features

- craftable music box
- hurt and death voices for Kurimanju and Shisa

### Fixes

- show each control tooltip once
- teleport following pets to owner before their chunk unloads
- revived pets no longer die again from a stale fall distance
- silence Usagi ambient and lower attack volume
- never target owner, players or same-owner pets
